categorizationMenu.name: HUD Item Categorization
categorizationMenu.label: Configure Categorization
categorizationMenu.hint: Define custom category sections, sub-sections, and boolean expressions for filtering HUD items.

enableCenterOnToken.name: Center on Token Button
enableCenterOnToken.hint: Display a button in the HUD control bar to recenter the canvas view on the active token.

hudOpacity.name: HUD Opacity
hudOpacity.hint: Controls the transparency of the Action Display HUD overlay.

hudScale.name: HUD Scale
hudScale.hint: Controls the overall scale of the HUD window and all its contents proportionally.

fontSize.name: Font Size (px)
fontSize.hint: Controls the base font size of the text and icons. The HUD window size will remain independent.

persistTabState.name: Persist Tab Selections
persistTabState.hint: If enabled, your active tab selections for each character are saved and restored whenever you re-open the HUD or refresh Foundry.

persistDetached.name: Persist Detached HUD on Click-Off
persistDetached.hint: If enabled, a detached HUD will stay open when clicking off the token, and will only close if you right-click the same token again.

toggleTabSelection.name: Toggle Tab Selections on Left-Click
toggleTabSelection.hint: If enabled, left-clicking a tab toggles its selection on or off (multi-select) instead of clearing other selected tabs. Selections are only cleared by clicking them again or clicking 'All'.

hudAnchorSide.name: HUD Attachment Side
hudAnchorSide.hint: Controls whether the Attached HUD anchors vertically (Above / Below) or horizontally (Left / Right) relative to the token.

hudGridOffset.name: HUD Grid Offset (Vertical)
hudGridOffset.hint: Controls the vertical distance (in grid units) to offset the HUD above or below the token.

hudGridOffsetHorizontal.name: HUD Grid Offset (Horizontal)
hudGridOffsetHorizontal.hint: Controls the horizontal distance (in grid units) to offset the HUD to the left or right of the token.

logVerbosity.name: Log Verbosity Level
logVerbosity.hint: Controls the level of detail printed to the browser console.

categorization.title: Bakana's HUD Categorization Configuration
categorization.enableHint: Organize HUD actions into categorized sections with custom divider bars utilizing user defined boolean expressions.
categorization.noCategories: No custom categories defined. Click '+ Add Category' to start.
categorization.emptyNameWarning: Category and subcategory names cannot be empty.
categorization.invalidExpressionWarning: The expression "{expr}" contains a syntax error.
categorization.expressionHelpTooltip:
Actions are evaluated against each category from top to bottom and placed in the first matching rule (true).
Unmatched actions appear in Other Actions.
Available Variables in Boolean Expressions:
  • item: Foundry Item document (e.g. item.type === 'weapon', item.name, item.system)
  • action: HUD Action instance (e.g. action.left, action.right, action.uses.available)
  • actor: Foundry Actor document (e.g. actor.getFlag('bakana-action-display', 'favorites')?.[item.id])
  • token: Foundry Token document (e.g. token.name)
  • user: Current Foundry User document (e.g. user.isGM, user.name)
